prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
engine_stated_criteria: Insight Timer — *Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing And Growth
answer_verbatim:
The **best online courses** for shadow work and spiritual practice are the ones that combine **guided inner-work exercises**, **Jungian or depth-psychology framing**, and, if you want the spiritual side, **meditations, journaling, or prayer/practice components**.[2][11][14][15]

Here are the strongest options from the results, grouped by fit:

- **Jung Platform — *Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work / Encounters with the Shadow***: Best if you want the most clearly **Jungian** and theory-grounded option; it is described as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work.[2][8]
- **Awake Academy — *Embracing The Shadow* with Charlie Morley**: Best if you want a more **transformative, spiritually oriented** course; the course is positioned around shadow integration and personal transformation.[17]
- **Sacred Humans Co. — *Inner Healing Shadow Work Course***: Best for a broader **healing + spirituality** blend, since it explicitly includes emotional regulation, spiritual awakening, relationships, and mindfulness.[14]
- **ManTalks — *Shadow Course***: Best if you want a structured **guided process** over several weeks; it is an 8-week immersive course focused on facing and integrating the shadow.[16]
- **Insight Timer — *Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing And Growth***: Best if you prefer a **meditation-platform** format and want something closer to spiritual practice than academic study.[10]
- **Udemy — *Shadow Work Course and Workbook* / *Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self* / *Shadow Work Essentials***: Best if you want a **lower-cost, self-paced introduction** with exercises, meditations, and workbook-style practice.[3][11][12]

A simple way to choose:
- Choose **Jung Platform** if you want the most credible **psychology-first** approach.[2][8]
- Choose **Awake Academy** or **Sacred Humans** if you want the strongest **spiritual practice** angle.[14][17]
- Choose **ManTalks** if you want a **longer guided journey**.[16]
- Choose **Udemy** or **Insight Timer** if you want **accessible, self-paced entry-level** learning.[10][11][12]

A note of caution: shadow work can involve intense emotions, and these courses vary a lot in depth and quality; the results here do not provide enough independent outcome data to rank them by effectiveness, so the best choice depends on whether you prioritize **Jungian depth, spiritual practice, structure, or affordability**.[2][10][14][16][17]

If you want, I can also turn this into a **top 5 ranked list by goal** — for example, *best for beginners*, *best for spirituality*, or *best for serious Jungian study*.
